preconditions.expression: n >= 1 and m >= 2 and n <= 200 and m <= 10**5
preconditions.description: Input constraints: n is the number of time-steps (1 ≤ n ≤ 200), m is the number of target banana counts (2 ≤ m ≤ 10^5).

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= t_i <= 2 for t_i, x_prime_i, y_i in operations) and all(1 <= y_i <= m for t_i, x_prime_i, y_i in operations)
preconditions.description: Each operation has t_i ∈ {1, 2} (type 1 or 2) and y_i ∈ [1, m], where operations is the list of parsed input lines.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= x_prime_i <= 10**5 * m for t_i, x_prime_i, y_i in operations if t_i == 1) and all(10**5 < x_prime_i <= 10**5 * m for t_i, x_prime_i, y_i in operations if t_i == 2)
preconditions.description: For type 1 operations, x'_i ∈ [1, 10^5 * m]; for type 2 operations, x'_i ∈ (10^5, 10^5 * m]. x_i = x'_i / 10^5.
The input contains exactly n operations, one per line.

postconditions.expression: len(output) == m and all(isinstance(x, int) for x in output) and all(-1 <= x <= n for x in output)
postconditions.description: Output is a list of m integers, each representing the earliest time-step (1 ≤ step ≤ n) to reach exactly j bananas, or -1 if impossible.

postconditions.expression: all(output[j-1] == -1 or (1 <= output[j-1] <= n and exists(sequence_of_choices, k_final == j)) for j in range(1, m+1))
postconditions.description: For each target j ∈ [1, m], output[j-1] is the smallest step s ∈ [1, n] where a sequence of choices (a_1, ..., a_s) exists such that applying the first s operations with those choices yields exactly j bananas (k_final = j). If no such s exists, output[j-1] = -1.

postconditions.expression: all(output[j-1] == -1 or all(output[j-1] == min_step for min_step in possible_steps(j)) for j in range(1, m+1))
postconditions.description: For each j ∈ [1, m], if possible_steps(j) is the set of steps where j bananas can be achieved, then output[j-1] is the minimum of possible_steps(j). If possible_steps(j) is empty, output[j-1] = -1.
